Name: Swordsmanship
Author: shunjianqin
Description:
[b]Become a sword-wielding cultivator![/b]

Hold one of the flying swords and [b]right-click to release it[/b]. The sword leaves your hand and freely circles around you in a wide area, acting on its own. Right-click again while holding a flying sword to call it back.

[size=4][b]What the flying swords do automatically[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Seek and attack monsters[/b] - flies to the nearest enemy and strikes using the game's own combat path, so death animations, loot drops, and combat XP all work normally.[/*]
[*][b]Harvest mature crops[/b] - collects ready crops straight into your inventory.[/*]
[*][b]Water dry soil[/b] - waters tilled, unwatered farmland.[/*]
[*][b]Pick up wild forage[/b] - gathers spawned forage items on the ground.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Two swords, stackable up to four[/b][/size]
Both swords are sold at the Adventurer's Guild.

Release a pair of Jianqin, then right-click a pair of Baihui to add them to the formation. Each sword picks its own target so they don't waste time striking the same enemy.

[size=4][b]How to use[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Hold a flying sword (Jianqin or Baihui).[/*]
[*]Right-click to release - the swords begin orbiting and working.[/*]
[*]Right-click while holding a flying sword to recall them.[/*]
[*]Swords follow you when you change locations.[/*]
[*]Behavior can be tuned in [b]config.json[/b] (speed, range, and toggles for harvesting / watering / combat).[/*]
[*]Default orbit radius is 9 tiles.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Unzip the downloaded file.[/*]
[*]Copy BOTH folders into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]
Designed for single-player. Multiplayer behavior is not officially tested; use at your own discretion.

[size=4][b]Changelog[/b][/size]
[b]1.0.0[/b]
[list]
[*]First release.[/*]
[*]Two flying swords: Jianqin and Baihui, stackable up to four.[/*]
[*]Auto combat (with loot drops), crop harvest, watering, and forage pickup.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: 飞剑
Manifest.Description: 新增武器「飞剑」：青玉为锋、灵金为柄。右键放出，剑身离手，自动盘旋索敌、收割作物、浇灌旱地。矿洞第 120 层后可在冒险家公会购买。
Manifest.Author: 剑琴

Manifest.Name: 飞剑·御剑术
Manifest.Description: 手持飞剑按下触发键（默认鼠标右键，可在 config.json 的 ToggleKey 配置；安卓可用虚拟按键映射该键）放出飞剑：剑脱手后在以你为中心的范围内自行盘旋，自动追击怪物、收割成熟作物、浇灌干地、拾取野生采集物，再按一次收回。
Manifest.Author: 剑琴
